readinessImpacts.title: What affects readiness
readinessImpacts.intro: Behaviours from your journal, ranked by their effect on next-day readiness. Correlation, not proof.
readinessImpacts.needsTail: Keep tagging to see their impact.
readinessImpacts.emptyBody: Answer your journal questions for a few days. Each behaviour needs {min} days with it and {min} days without it before it shows here.
readinessImpacts.info.title: How impacts work
readinessImpacts.info.body: For each behaviour, OpenHoop compares your readiness the morning after days you logged it with the morning after days you did not. The percentage is the difference between those two averages.
readinessImpacts.info.confidence: Confidence grows with more logged days and a steadier difference. Low confidence means the difference could easily be chance.
